# CHANGELOG

## UNRELEASED — BRING-YOUR-OWN-KEY AI LAYER (2026-10-24)

AI across the app with **no subscription model**: the operator supplies their own provider key once, and every AI feature activates globally.

- **Storage & Settings UI** — Administration → Settings → *AI provider (Bring Your Own Key)* card: provider select (Google Gemini default / OpenAI / Groq), model override, write-only key input with reveal toggle, Test / Replace / Remove actions, masked `••••1234` status (never the raw key), honest "not configured" capture hint and vault-secret posture warning. Key encrypted at rest AES-256-GCM (`src/lib/ai/key-vault.ts`, scrypt per-record salt+IV) in the existing `AIConnector.configJson` — **no schema change**; audit-logged (masked only).
- **Central brain** — `src/lib/ai/ai-service.ts` (first `"use server"` module): `askAI(prompt, systemContext)` + `askAIResult` fetch the session from the auth cookie, enforce RBAC (`ai.use`, `admin.config`), rate-limit (10/min), decrypt the key and call `complete()`. Never throws: missing/invalid/rate-limited/timeout/network failures return typed status + graceful fallback string; every call ledgered to `AIExecution`.
- **Providers** — `src/lib/ai/providers.ts`: Gemini via official `@google/genai` SDK (lazy import), OpenAI + Groq via OpenAI-compatible fetch (zero extra deps); 30 s timeout, HTTP+message error classification. Swapping vendors = registry entry + one adapter.
- **Examples** — Example A Kanban: task slide-over *AI sub-tasks* → 3 ordered sub-tasks (skeleton loading, JSON parse guards, fallback box). Example B Dashboard: *Executive brief* over the overdue-milestone list (≤120 words, button-triggered, hidden when nothing overdue).
- **Verification** — new `tests/engines/ai-byok.test.ts` (vault round-trip/tamper/mask-leak, error classification, fallback coverage, parsing contracts); tsc/eslint/tests/final-verify gates green. Docs: `docs/AI-BYOK-ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## 3.1.0 - UNIVERSAL POWERPOINT EXPORT (2026-09-20)

Export any module as a presentation-native 16:9 deck, from the browser dashboard AND the Windows desktop application - both call the same server-side engine, so output is identical.

- **Universal availability**: standardized Export-PPT button in the app shell topbar; maps the current route to an exportable view and the current project context automatically.
- **42 exportable views**: executive + leadership towers, portfolios, programs, projects, strategy, prioritization, investment; project full-deck (overview, Gantt, dependencies, milestones, financials + EVM, RAID, changes, gates, agile, deliverables); requirements, WBS, tasks, schedule, milestones, baselines, project financials, EVM, health, RAID, changes, gates, agile, boards, field ops, proofing; portfolio financials, clients + billing, resources, workload, timesheets, governance, decisions, actions, KPIs, feedback, roadmap, docs, CTO tower, analytics.
- **Intelligent data fitting**: fixed row budgets per slide with repeated headers and per-column character budgets (never wraps or overlaps); Gantt renders as native shapes on a real month/date axis with today marker, critical path, progress fills and milestone diamonds, split across parts sharing one axis so bars align; charts are native PPT vector charts (doughnut, bar, line).
- **Project-specific alignment**: cover slide with project metadata (status/phase, health RAG, budget vs actual vs forecast, dates, strategic objective), project line in every slide header, confidentiality footer from Admin Settings, automatic slide numbers.
- **API**: POST /api/export/ppt { view, projectId? } (reports.view or project.view; audited EXPORT; 20/min rate limit).
- Engine: src/lib/engines/pptx.ts + pptx-views.ts (pptxgenjs, serverExternalPackages-isolated); registry src/lib/pptx/registry.ts.

## 3.0.0 — COMMAND CENTER EXPANSION (2026-09-19)

Omni-functional unified execution platform release: closes the six missing capability clusters vs the 40-app "Command Center" mega-scope, all on the single Project/Task core (see `docs/COMMAND-CENTER-PRD.md` for the full PRD, architecture, ERD and per-app coverage matrix).

**Agile & Scrum (`/agile`)** — Sprints (PLANNED/ACTIVE/COMPLETED, one active per project, sprint goals + date windows), Epics (color-coded themes with business value), story points (Fibonacci picker, server-recomputed committed points), backlog grooming with pull-into-sprint, drag-and-drop sprint board (dnd-kit) with optimistic card moves. Task gains `sprintId`/`epicId`/`storyPoints`/`backlogOrder`.

**Omni task views (`/boards`)** — the same Task entity as Kanban (status lanes, cross-project or per-project, drag & drop, drag overlay), delivery Calendar (month grid of task due dates + meetings, today marker, weekend shading), and Workload heatmap (resource × week utilization from `/api/capacity`, over-allocation in red, 4–26 week window).

**Product strategy (`/feedback`)** — feedback portal with one-vote-per-user toggling, triage workflow (NEW → UNDER_REVIEW → PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS → SHIPPED/DECLINED), and quarter-based Roadmap (progress bars, release tags, feedback→roadmap demand linking).

**Knowledge & communication (`/docs`, `/boards-hub`)** — Docs-first workspace: six spaces, markdown pages with tables/checklists, search, edit/preview; Message Boards: pinned announcements, standups, Q&A threads with reply counts and last-activity ordering, built on the generic Comment primitive.

**Commercial operations (`/clients`)** — Client register (revenue roll-ups per client), Invoices with line items (server-computed subtotal/tax/total, DRAFT→SENT→PAID lifecycle, paid invoices locked, milestone/task-linked lines), Expenses with approval workflow (PENDING→APPROVED/REJECTED→REIMBURSED, billable tracking, category roll-ups).

**Field operations (`/field`)** — RFI register with aging discipline (unanswered >7d flagged, cost + schedule impact totals, answer workflow), Daily construction logs (weather/crew/work/delays/safety), Punch list with OPEN→IN_PROGRESS→CLOSED→VERIFIED verification chain, BIM model viewer (embeddable ACC/model-service URL).

**Proofing & approvals (`/proofing`)** — versioned proof rounds per deliverable (auto round numbering, reviewer + due date), threaded annotations with page/timecode locators and resolve toggling, APPROVED / CHANGES_REQUESTED decisions with reopen.

**Platform** — 16 new Prisma models + Task/Project extensions (schema pushed additively); 20 new API route files (all withApi: JWT → RBAC → zod → audit → rate-limit → realtime); 7 new permission codes (`agile.manage`, `client.manage`, `field.manage`, `product.manage`, `docs.use`, `boards.use`, `proofing.manage`) mapped into all 8 role templates + `scripts/sync-rbac.ts` for live-DB upsert; new "Strategy & Knowledge" nav group; realtime events `agile:changed`/`field:changed`; idempotent `scripts/seed-command-center.ts` (`npm run seed:command-center`).

**Verification** — prisma validate/push clean; tsc clean for all new code (pre-existing unrelated errors unchanged); live smoke tests: 13 GET endpoints 200 + 10 mutation flows pass; RBAC negative matrix (TEAM_MEMBER 403 on client/field/product mutations, allowed on card moves/votes); GUI pass over all 8 views with screenshots in `gui-test-screenshots/`.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.2 — IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS PACKAGE + DOC SWEEP (2026-09-13)

- New **Important Documents** folder: platform overview, test plan, test report (Word), platform audit, integrity guide, deployment guide, sales deck — the executive document set in one place.
- CHANGELOG backfilled (v1.7.2 report viewer); README capability map updated through v1.9.1 (Admin Control Center).

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.

- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.

- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. - **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.

- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.3.0 — FINANCIAL DEPTH + ANOMALY DETECTION (2026-09-13)

- **Portfolio Financial API**: Budget/Committed/Actual/Forecast per project + portfolio totals, CAPEX/OPEX ready, forecast variance.
- **Anomaly detection**: statistical >2σ deviation flagging on cost burn rate against portfolio mean.

## 2.2.0 — DELIVERY DEPTH: UAT + DOCS + WHAT-IF (2026-09-13)

- **UAT cycles/cases**: create cycles, add cases (with severity), record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results with executor+defectRef. Pass-rate computed. **Hard gate lock**: critical FAIL blocks Go-Live gate (checked server-side).
- **Documents**: upload/list text documents per project with version increment.
- **Schedule What-If**: POST /api/projects/[id]/whatif {taskId, deltaDays} — runs CPM with modified task and returns finish delta; scenarios saved.

## 2.1.0 — ECOSYSTEM SYNC ENGINE (2026-09-13)

- Sync adapters for Jira (REST+JQL), Azure DevOps (WIQL+batch), ServiceNow (Table API) with live connection tests.
- POST /api/integrations/sync {integrationId, action:test|sync}: test flips CONFIGURED→CONNECTED only after a live authenticated round-trip; sync pulls external items and reports results. Audited.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.

- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.

- CHANGELOG backfilled (v1.7.2 report viewer); README capability map updated through v1.9.1 (Admin Control Center).

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 1.9.1 — CUSTOM FIELDS LIVE IN THE PROJECT LIFECYCLE (2026-09-13)

- POST /api/projects now accepts customFields and **enforces published FieldDefinitions server-side**: required validation (tested live — missing Business Criticality BLOCKS creation with the exact message), type coercion (number/date/boolean/select), option whitelisting.
- Persisted as customFieldsJson on the Project record and returned through the project detail API.
- Dynamic form rendering of custom fields in the project UI + PATCH support next.

## 1.9.0 — ADMIN CONTROL CENTER, PHASE A (2026-09-13)

- **Metadata-driven configuration layer**: EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition (with optionsJson, sensitive, DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED), CustomFieldType (14 base types incl. RAG/SCORE/FORMULA), NamingConvention (snake/camel/Pascal/UPPER + prefix/suffix + code patterns with YEAR/SEQ tokens), Terminology dictionary, FeatureFlags, AdminSettings — all audited, admin.config-gated.
- **Field Builder**: publish fields per entity; internal API names auto-generated from the naming convention (stable forever); SELECT/RAG option enforcement + required validation executed server-side.
- **Terminology**: rename application terms organization-wide (Project -> Engagement) with stable internal identifiers.
- **Live verified**: field type + field creation with convention-derived name (business_criticality), required-field enforcement, terminology rename.
- Phase B roadmap: dynamic form rendering of custom fields in project forms, workflow builder, dashboard builder, configuration versioning/rollback, multi-tenant isolation.

## 2.0.0 — ENTERPRISE IDENTITY & ACCESS (2026-09-13)

- **OIDC SSO flow**: /api/auth/sso/start (authorize redirect) + callback with code exchange, IdP group→role mapping, JIT user/role provisioning, PMCT session token. IdP registry in Admin (admin/sso) with honest CONFIGURED status.
- **SCIM 2.0 provisioning** (RFC 7644 subset): /api/scim/v2/Users with bearer token auth (SHA-256 hashed tokens, shown once), JIT create, filter, activate/deactivate via PATCH — all audited.
- **MFA (TOTP RFC 6238)**: setup → authenticator app → enable → MFA login challenge; failed challenges audited.
- **User model**: mfaEnabled/mfaSecret/externalId/authSource fields; IdentityProvider + ScimToken models.
- Live verified: IdP registration (CONFIGURED), SCIM JIT create + filter, MFA setup with otpauth URL.
